objective: Challenge the feasibility of portable evidence-based support auditing before building an analyzer.

ideas.text: Independent humans can distinguish visible handling defects from justified denials and unknown outcomes under a shared rubric. Falsify with blinded review and control-case disagreements.
An existing configured QA rubric may already meet the portable-audit need. Test adequacy before product implementation.
Customer-visible exports may leave too many outcomes unknown for useful verification. Report unknown cases and review burden rather than forcing verdicts.
